trim my vacation.mp4 to the first 5 seconds and convert it to a gif with ffmpeg

the reply proposes exactly one change for the next take, not both at once, and says the other comes after
the identity fix keeps the bible's identity string verbatim (braid included) rather than rewording it
judge: the seed advice is right for an end-of-clip or whole-clip problem, never 'change everything' (2 of 3 votes)
